criteria.text: An authorized pause request uses the existing loop and goal pause sentinels and returns a clear requested state without executing arbitrary input.
An authorized resume request delegates to the existing loop or goal runner, respects the project lock, and refuses duplicate starts.
Authorized operator notes are bounded, append-only, escaped on read, and visible as project-local timeline data.
Authorized change requests reuse the existing append-only change inbox and return a durable request identifier and pending state.
